name: creatoros-youtube
description: Ask Claude how your YouTube channel is really doing: private analytics, per-video bottlenecks, fair comparisons, best publishing times and audience questions. Read-only; runs locally on your computer.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: From Google Cloud Console > Google Auth Platform > Clients > your 'Desktop app' client (ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com). See README > Configuration.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: The client secret of the same Desktop app client. Stored in secure storage.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API key (optional)
youtube_api_key.description: Only needed to read comments. Restrict it to 'YouTube Data API v3'. Stored in secure storage.
